game.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War Zombies
game.rules:
We ask that you please be patient with the moderation staff.

# *General Rule List*

- You should be familiar with the [general site rules](https://www.speedrun.com/knowledgebase/site-rules), specifically the sections "Submitting a Run" and "General Gameplay Rules"
- Video is mandatory, you are not allowed to submit screenshots
- For Co-Op runs the one who is recording must submit the run
- Your entire run must be captured, we will not search for it.
- Must submit a highlight from a twitch run and not your entire stream, we will deny it.
- Full footage is required. (Including spawning in.)
- Using weapons from bundles that spawn with an element attached to them IS NOT allowed in runs
- Games MUST be played on the latest version
- Playing on the "Cranked" game mode is not allowed, your run will be denied.

# *Additional Notes*

- If someone joins midway through your run, you must submit it as an additional coop run. i.e. if you had 2 people and another joined, you submit as 3 people; however, if they join then instantly leave without gaining any points you may still submit as 2 player
- .77 on your timer does not equal .077 when you submit your time, it equals .770. When you submit the milliseconds you should type it in as 770 or else it will show up as 077.

More information can be found in [this thread](https://www.speedrun.com/bocwz/thread/fz0my)
